arguments: Shapes on Base are ETH-backed onchain objects, a separate collection from Shapes on Ethereum: the same contract and rules, with independent tokens and ETH. Each Shape wraps an exact amount of ETH on Base; redeeming it returns exactly that amount. Artwork and metadata are generated entirely onchain.

The contract owner token of Shapes on Base. Its current holder is returned by owner() and has no administrative authority. Ownership moves with this Shape through compose, decompose and split. Redeeming or burning it ends contract ownership.
